feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Civil servant who juggled up to five government jobs guilty of fraud
articles.summary: A civil servant has been found guilty of nine counts of fraud after using remote working and sick notes to juggle up to five full-time government jobs at the same time.

articles.title: Thames Water agrees funding into next year ahead of looming deadline
articles.summary: The UK's biggest water company has agreed to a funding deal, allowing it to continue operating until autumn next year ahead of a November deadline.

articles.title: Fire that killed mother, children and family dog 'caused by electrical appliances'
articles.summary: A mother, her two children, and the family dog were killed after a fire believed to have been caused by electrical appliances engulfed their home on Boxing Day, an inquest heard.

articles.title: James Bulger's killer Jon Venables to stay in prison after parole refused
articles.summary: Child killer Jon Venables will stay behind bars after the Parole Board found he still poses a risk to children.

articles.title: Met Office issues fog warning for second day - with wind and rain to follow
articles.summary: A new warning for dense fog has been issued by the Met Office – with people being told to expect "difficult travelling conditions".

articles.title: Octopus Energy sparks COP31 dealmaking with new Asian fund
articles.summary: One of Britain's most valuable private companies is extending its global tentacles further into Asia by launching a renewables fund to coincide with the COP31 climate summit.

articles.title: Ground Force presenter Tommy Walsh has died
articles.summary: Ground Force presenter Tommy Walsh has died at the age of 69 following a "long illness", his agent has confirmed.

articles.title: Government considering banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
articles.summary: The government is seriously considering banning children from online sales platforms such as eBay and Vinted, the culture secretary has said.

articles.title: Schools to stop teaching GCSEs early in curriculum overhaul
articles.summary: Secondary schools will be told to stop teaching GCSEs to students until they reach Year 10 in a bid to keep younger children engaged, according to the government.

articles.title: Two teenagers arrested after boys chased with sword in Gloucester
articles.summary: Two teenagers have been arrested after a boy was attacked with a sword in Tuffley, police said.
